name: Sticker pop
tagline: Zine sticker collage — acid yellow field, die-cut stickers, marker scribbles
technique: Zine and sticker-sheet collage of the 2000s revival: flat acid color field, die-cut vinyl stickers with thick white borders, cut-out photos, black marker scribbles and arrows, pill-shaped chips.

plates.accept: Acid-yellow field, stickers and scribbles only on the right; left half empty; no text.
Sticker cluster on lilac; no text inside the bubble; no faces.
Three torn paper layers with a marker circle; no text.
One even row of stickers on white; nothing else.
Natural anatomy (five fingers, plausible limbs), eyes hidden by sunglasses, thick white sticker border, flat pure-green background all around; no text.
One sticker with white border on flat pure green; no text.
One sticker with white border on flat pure green; no text.
One sticker with white border on flat pure green; no text.

generate.base: A single die-cut vinyl sticker of {subject} in a flat zine-collage style: bold black outlines, flat fills in acid yellow, lilac, black and white, slightly wobbly hand-cut shapes, a thick white sticker border around the whole silhouette. No faces unless hidden by sunglasses.
generate.spot: A single die-cut vinyl sticker of {subject}, drawn in a flat zine-collage style: bold black outlines, flat lilac and yellow fills, slightly wobbly hand-cut shapes, a thick white sticker border around the whole silhouette.
generate.figure: A full-body photograph of {subject}, shot with a hard on-camera flash like a fashion editorial, sharp focus, natural proportions and hands, dark round sunglasses that hide the eyes, no face recognisable. The whole figure is presented as a die-cut sticker with a thick white border around the silhouette.
generate.rules: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature anywhere in the image.

prompts.hero.webp: A flat-lay collage photographed from directly above: a sheet of acid-yellow (#e8ff3a) poster paper covering the whole frame, with a torn strip of white paper laid diagonally across the lower right, several glossy die-cut vinyl stickers with thick white borders scattered on the right half (a pixel-art smiley, two lightning bolts, a four-point sparkle, a cassette tape, a lilac star), hand-drawn black marker scribbles and one big marker arrow. The left half of the yellow sheet stays empty. Flat, hard even lighting, no perspective. No faces, no people. Every sticker and shape is filled only with acid yellow, lilac, black and white — no other colors, flat zine artwork with bold black outlines, no gloss, no gradients, no shading. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature anywhere in the image.
